description: Adopt shared logging for supersets and circuits (#670; REQ-019, C45; R82, R100, R115, R116; TASK-AC-A6979DFEDE2D, TASK-AC-FCC746654DD9, TASK-AC-3830472CD65C; foundation provider for JOURNEY-019). On the real /workout route the superset and circuit family's entries - the superset round (SupersetBlock -> SupersetRoundSheet) and its movements' saved-set corrections (ExerciseSetLogger focused), the circuit round and its Undo (CircuitBlock Round N recorded, TASK-021) and the circuit movement entry (CircuitBlock -> ExerciseSetLogger focused) - open in the shared focused LoggingOverlay (src/ui/refinements/logging-overlay.tsx): a native modal over an inert workout, titled with the entry title, closed by its framed icon-only Close log X or Escape, with the Balanced backdrop and no half-sheet. Each keeps its fields (per-movement Performed, load/unit/measure and Effort; the movement actual entry; round time, the circuit rest and Take back this round), its draft, the original set-observation writer (insert, correct, clear), the TASK-020 Save confirmation and the one rest; an unticked movement is never logged and a movement entry records no round. check-01 proves it in the browser on a contained synthetic session at 390 (superset round touch; superset correction keyboard and reduced motion with a refused write retried under its own id) and 320 (circuit round, Undo and movement entry), and opens the accepted gallery states ?state=superset, circuit-round and circuit-movement (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d, the route SupersetBlock and CircuitBlock over an in-memory set-observation client) in all four skins at 390. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-044 --check check-01 -- npx playwright test e2e/refinement/task-044.spec.ts --project=mobile
